result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its five entry names and the files it reads from the configured aspect names. I compiled the `reports` module, which passed. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed aspect.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the zip step of the export. It no longer uses the fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals. It builds the five scope aspects in the same order (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other). For each one it gets the name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`. That's the same method that names the loose text files, so the two always match.

With the default configuration the entries are the same as before. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written after `all_files.zip` in the same block, so it comes back too when `git-history.txt` exists.

`LandscapeAnalyzer.java` (lines 280–284) still reads `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` and the other fixed `aspect_*.txt` names, so landscape analysis would still miss a renamed aspect. I left it alone because it's outside this task.
